mainEntity.name: How do I write a note on a verse?

acceptedAnswer.text: Press the verse number and choose Note, or open the composer with Ctrl/⌘ J. Notes are written in simple Markdown and belong to the passage, so they appear in every translation.

mainEntity.name: How do I see all my notes?

acceptedAnswer.text: All notes lists every note in one table, to filter, sort, open or export.

mainEntity.name: How do I link notes together?

acceptedAnswer.text: Write [[Genesis 1]] in a note to link to a chapter, and #theme to tag it. The Links pane shows what points at the chapter being read, and the Tags pane gathers notes by tag.
